newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates mostly flat in thin volume.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates mostly flat in thin volume.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at mostly steady levels in thin volume at the St. Louis Merchants Exchange. No barges traded versus none on Friday.
- Two barges, this week, lower Ohio River, bid 100 percent of tariff, no offer.
- Two barges, this week, St Louis (Mississippi), bid 120 percent, no offer.
- Two barges, next week, St Louis (Mississippi), bid 105 percent, no offer.
